concerns.text: T018 ('Implement check_network_saturation()') is marked as DEPENDS ON T014a, but T018 is listed BEFORE T014a in the task sequence. T014a (instrumentor_remote.py) must be implemented before T018 can utilize its functions. This violates the producer-before-consumer rule.

T019 ('Implement detect_dropout_events()') is marked as DEPENDS ON T013, but T019 is listed BEFORE T013 in the task sequence. T013 (node_manager.py) must be implemented before T019 can access its heartbeat logic.
T020 ('Implement capture_unmodeled_vars()') is marked as DEPENDS ON T014a, but T020 is listed BEFORE T014a. T014a must precede T020.

T017 ('Implement data_collector.py') depends on T014b and T016, but T017 is listed BEFORE T014b and T016. The data collector cannot be implemented before the parsers and benchmark runners it consumes.
T014b ('Implement mpstat_parser.py') depends on T014a, but T014b is listed BEFORE T014a. The parser cannot be implemented before the instrumentor that generates the raw output.
T037 ('Implement calibration.py') depends on T036 and T017, but T037 is listed BEFORE T036. The calibration logic cannot be implemented before the DES model it calibrates.
T038 ('Implement internal_state_validator.py') depends on T037, but T038 is listed BEFORE T037. The validator cannot be implemented before the calibration logic it validates.
T046 ('Patch node_manager.py') depends on T013, but T046 is listed BEFORE T013. The patch task cannot be defined before the base task it modifies.
T047 ('Patch scheduler.py') depends on T015, but T047 is listed BEFORE T015. The patch task cannot be defined before the base task it modifies.
T049 ('Patch data_validator.py') depends on T010, but T049 is listed BEFORE T010. The patch task cannot be defined before the base task it modifies.

T014a and T014b are split into separate tasks but listed in reverse dependency order (T014b before T014a). While the dependency note exists, the linear ordering in the list implies T014b can be done first, which is semantically incorrect.
